study.title: MSEA-Net: Multi-Scale and Edge-Aware Network for Weed Segmentation
study.short_title: MSEA-Net lightweight weed seg: mIoU 87.42 (sorghum), 71.35 (CoFly); 6.74M params

segmentation.domain: UAV weed segmentation with a lightweight encoder-decoder (Multi-Scale Spatial-Channel Attention MSCA + Edge-Enhanced Bottleneck Attention EEBA with Sobel edge detection), aimed at real-time deployment on resource-constrained UAVs; evaluated on two public UAV datasets
models_tested: SegNet (backbones: VGG16, ResNet50, DenseNet121, EfficientNetB0, MobileNetV2)
segmentation.best_model: MSEA-Net: mIoU 87.42% (test) / 88.28% (validation) on Motion-Blurred UAV Images of Sorghum Fields (F1 0.9307, precision 0.9354, recall 0.9261; per-class IoU: bg 99.19, crop/sorghum 84.00, weed 79.08); mIoU 71.35% on CoFly-WeedDB (IoU bg 88.72, weed 53.99); 6.74M params, 25.74 MB. Best baselines: UNet+EfficientNetB0 85.34% mIoU (sorghum), SegNet+DenseNet121 67.56% (CoFly)

dataset.name: Primary: Motion-Blurred UAV Images of Sorghum Fields (Genze et al., Mendeley 4hh45vkp38/5): 6300 patches of 256x256 extracted from 19 UAV images (5472x3648) of an experimental sorghum field in Southern Germany, DJI Mavic 2 Pro 20 MP Hasselblad L1D-20c, GSD 1 mm, classes sorghum/weed/soil. Secondary: CoFly-WeedDB: 201 UAV images (1280x720) over cotton fields in Greece, DJI Phantom Pro 4, 5 m altitude, 3 weed types (Johnson grass, field bindweed, purslane) + background, reduced to binary weed-vs-background for experiments (786 patches of 256x256)
dataset.note: Patches 256x256 with flip/rotation/grid-distortion augmentation; 80/10/10 train/val/test split; early stopping on validation loss (patience 20); 200 epochs, Adam lr 0.002, batch 64. Sorghum GSD 1 mm (motion-blurred imagery); CoFly flown at 5 m altitude, DJI Phantom Pro 4.

segmentation.backbone: Custom lightweight encoder-decoder with hierarchical convolutions (1x1 -> 3x3 -> 3x3), spatial attention (SPA) depthwise+pointwise residual blocks, squeeze-and-excitation channel recalibration (MSCA module), and Sobel-based edge-aware bottleneck attention (EEBA); Dice-Focal bounded loss (binary) / cross-entropy (multi-class)

mIoU.quote: On the Motion-Blurred UAV Images of Sorghum Fields dataset (Table 4), MSEA-Net again achieves the highest mean IoU (87.42%)
mIoU.ambiguity: Mean IoU over 3 classes (background/sorghum/weed) on the primary sorghum dataset: IoU bg 99.19%, crop 84.00%, weed 79.08%. Secondary CoFly-WeedDB: mIoU 71.35%, IoU weed 53.99%. Validation-set mIoU 88.28% (Table 8); 5-fold CV 87.21 +/- 0.31%.

mPA.ambiguity: Pixel accuracy not reported; mean IoU and per-class IoU used.

F1.quote: It also demonstrates superior precision (93.54%), recall (92.61%), and F1-score (93.07%)
F1.ambiguity: Weighted F1 on the primary sorghum dataset (0.9307); F1 0.9302 +/- 0.18 in 5-fold CV. CoFly-WeedDB F1 0.9017.

Dice.ambiguity: Dice-Focal loss used for training, but Dice/F1 index not reported as an evaluation metric (F1-score reported instead).

weed_F1.ambiguity: Per-class F1 not reported; per-class IoU reported (weed 79.08% on sorghum, 53.99% on CoFly).

crop_F1.ambiguity: Per-class F1 not reported; crop/sorghum IoU 84.00%.

edge.framework: PyTorch 2.4.0 (Python 3.8.9), Adam lr 0.002, batch 64, 200 epochs, early stop patience 20

fps.ambiguity: FPS not reported; inference time per image 0.0020 s implies ~500 FPS on the measurement GPU (see latency_ms).

latency_ms.quote: MSEA-Net achieves an average inference time of 0.0020 s per image
latency_ms.ambiguity: Measured on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU (desktop), NOT on an embedded/edge device; edge.reported=false. The paper argues real-time UAV/embedded suitability (6.74M params, 25.74MB) but performs no on-device deployment.

params_M.quote: MSEA-Net maintains only 6.74 M parameters and a model size of 25.74 MB
params_M.ambiguity: Structural figure; ablation shows parameters vary (w/o MSCA 10.49M, w/o MSCA+EEBA 9.60M).

issues: Primary metrics from Motion-Blurred Sorghum dataset (3-class bg/sorghum/weed); CoFly-WeedDB evaluated as binary weed-vs-background (mIoU 71.35%, weed IoU 53.99%).
edge.reported=false: 2 ms/image inference measured on a desktop RTX 4090; no embedded/on-device measurement despite 'suitable for UAV real-time deployment' claim.
Ablation: removing MSCA drops CoFly mIoU by 14.3 pts (71.35->57.05); EEBA removal drops weed IoU on sorghum by 2.37 pts; EEBA adds no parameters.
No FPS, power or FLOPs reported.
